segments.title: Discord Outage & Topless Policy Debate
segments.notes: Case opens broadcast discussing Discord server issues and debates Twitch's topless policy double standards with chat.

segments.title: Biscord Interview: Discord PR Response
segments.notes: Pepito connects Case with 'Biscord' (Dronovan), Discord's PR representative, who denies outage issues and announces AI bot return.

segments.title: Fucks List & Twitch Nudity Rollback
segments.notes: Case reviews the 400+ entry Fucks List; reads Twitch's official statement rolling back artistic nudity policy effective today.

segments.title: Trip on the Street: Erotic Opinions
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews park denizens about erotic fighting, Venus fly trap encounters, hentai, time travel, and 9/11 warnings.

segments.title: Conspiracy Time: Michael Jackson's Voice & Nipple Racism
segments.notes: Case investigates YouTube videos claiming Michael Jackson's real voice was deeper, and a Japanese commercial suggesting nipples are racist.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Boobs on Twitch Debate
segments.notes: Munch debates 'Eugene Scrum' (Crum in disguise) about Twitch nudity; Crum refuses to take the con position, Munch declares victory.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Three Trailers
segments.notes: Trent reviews trailers for The American Society of Magical Negroes, IF (Ryan Reynolds), and Ballistic: Ecks vs Sever (1990s).

segments.title: Closing: Pepito Poll & Raid
segments.notes: Crum returns for keys; Pepito voted permanent producer; raid to Dank Sauce with Grunch Miss Sunday announcement.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored broadcast covering Discord outage, Twitch nudity rollback, conspiracy theories, and trailers; moderated Munch & Crum debate.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Connected Case to Biscord; voted permanent producer via dog poll; demanded scraps raise.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walked through studio; discussed Twitch nudity meta and nipple color theory; agreed to Sunday Grunch Miss stream.

characters.name: Biscord (Dronovan)
characters.notes: call-in guest. Discord PR spokesperson who denied outages, announced AI bot return, and claimed Discord kittens don't exist.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducted street interviews on erotic fighting, hentai, time travel, and 9/11 from park bushes.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated 'Eugene Scrum' on Twitch nudity; declared victory when Crum refused to oppose boobs; sang 'Fat Bottom Girls'.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Pretended to be 'Eugene Scrum' to avoid debating; agreed with Munch on boobs; returned for keys and contract discussion.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: correspondent. Hosted Trent at the Movies segment reviewing three trailers including Ryan Reynolds' IF and 90s Ballistic: Ecks vs Sever.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered Discord's server outage and Twitch's same-day rollback of its artistic nudity policy after AI-generated deepfake concerns. Trip Bradstein canvassed park opinions on erotic fighting and hentai, while conspiracy time examined Michael Jackson's alleged deeper voice and a Japanese milk commercial implying nipple racism. Munch debated a disguised Crum ('Eugene Scrum') on Twitch nudity, declaring victory when Crum refused the con position. Trent reviewed three trailers, and Pepito was voted permanent producer before a raid to Dank Sauce.
